$comment: `assertions` counts regex LITERALS passed to an assertion matcher (toMatch,
toThrow, toThrowError, stringMatching, toHaveBeenCalledWith) in *.test.* and
*.spec.* files. Comments are stripped first, so prose quoting a matcher does
Operator, 2026-08-26: "Regex is forbidden for being brittle." A regex
assertion fails in BOTH directions — reword the copy and a correct
implementation fails; reword the FAILURE message and the negative assertion
THIS NUMBER MAY ONLY GO DOWN. It is not a target to hit in one sweep; 679
assertions is a backlog no single PR should touch. The ratchet exists so the
backlog cannot grow while it is worked off.
To lower it: replace the assertion with one on the OUTCOME rather than the
wording, then lower this file in the same PR.
`unknown` is files that could not be read. It is not clean. It may not grow.
